description.value: Momo Factory Davie is a Nepali-Indian-Chinese fusion restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, specializing in Mo:Mo: dumplings in steamed, deep-fried, and jhol (sauce-dipped) styles alongside curries, stir-fries, and street snacks. The kitchen is led by Chef Shankar Bhandari, who brings over 20 years of experience spanning Nepal, India, and international venues. It is one of several locations in Metro Vancouver operated under the Momo Factory brand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Downtown Vancouver location at 1143 Davie St with phone +1 (604) 559-9238, matching OSM exactly. OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Order takeout from our website or your on-demand food delivery services' language; OSM diet:vegetarian=yes is corroborated by multiple veg menu items (Veg Momo, Veg Kurkure, etc.). No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Website consistently misspells the brand as 'Momo Factroy' (transposed letters) — may indicate a hastily built or unmaintained web presence.
Website contact page shows a placeholder booking email 'booking@domainame.com', suggesting the site was built from a template and not fully updated.
Generic toll-free booking number +1-800-852-9001 appears on the website alongside real location-specific numbers; may be a template artifact.
OSM name is 'Momo Factory Davie' but the website refers to this location as 'MoMo Factory Downtown Vancouver' — minor name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, confirmed-open restaurant on a key Vancouver cycling corridor (Davie Street, West End) with takeout and vegetarian options well-suited to touring cyclists.
